blocked_reason: The retargeted e2e is CORRECT and staged, but its playwright verification is RED because of an UPSTREAM WI-5 (web/src) assembly defect: after Accept the map-first /driver screen never renders the ride view. The e2e faithfully encodes WI-5's own AC ('Accept -> no nav -> the shared /driver screen reactively renders the ride view from useActiveOrderStore + useDriverMe'); the app does not deliver that contract. WI-6 scope is web/e2e ONLY — I must NOT and did NOT touch web/src to make it green (doing so would mask a shipping bug: a real driver accepts and sees a blank map). root_cause: PROVEN by static grep (no re-run needed): the ONLY writer of useActiveOrderStore.setOrder in web/src is useRideRestore.ts:83. useRideRestore runs ONLY on mount (useEffect deps [myDriverId]) — it reconciles the active order from GET /drivers/me.activeOrderId at mount time. In the map-first flow, driver2 mounts /driver Free (no active order) so restore CLEARS the store; then Accept is clicked. But (a) useOfferAccept only POSTs accept + returns {type:'success'} (writes NO store), (b) useLiveClear only CLEARS the store on reassignment (never hydrates), (c) Accept no longer navigates (WI-5 removed /driver/ride), so DriverMapScreen never remounts and useRideRestore never re-runs. Net: nothing hydrates useActiveOrderStore on accept -> useActiveOrder().order stays null -> DriverMapScreen renders the Free panel, never <RideSheet> -> 'Jsem na místě' never appears. In the OLD flow OfferTakeover navigated to /driver/ride, which MOUNTED DriverRidePage fresh -> its useRideRestore ran on that mount -> fetched /drivers/me -> got the now-active order -> hydrated the store. The navigation WAS the hydration trigger; WI-5 removed the navigation without replacing the trigger. WI-5's unit tests vi.mock useActiveOrder to RETURN an order, so they never exercised the accept->hydration path (the CLAUDE.md 'mocked tests pass, real flow breaks / zustand-object-selector' class of trap).
fix_direction_for_conductor: web/src fix (NOT WI-6; belongs to a WI-5 follow-up / fix-agent): DriverMapScreen must hydrate useActiveOrderStore when an accept lands with no navigation. Options: (1) OfferCard's onDismiss (or a new onAccepted callback) triggers a re-run of reconcileActiveRide -> setOrder; (2) DriverMapScreen listens for a 'driver:orderChanged'/'driver:statusChanged' (own driverId -> Busy) event and re-reconciles / setOrder from the accepted order; (3) invalidate ['driver','me'] on accept and re-restore when activeOrderId flips non-null. Do NOT 'fix' this in the e2e with page.reload()/navigate after accept — that masks the bug (a real driver does not reload after accepting). Keep the e2e as the red guard.
